intro: What this record's partner is asked to approve — a sample, a colour, a leather, an artwork, a design proof, a concession, a revised order or a signature — and how they answered.

empty.title: Nothing asked yet
empty.body: Ask the partner to approve a photo, a proof or a change: they answer by link or in their portal, signed with their name.

held.noRight: Asking a partner to approve needs the right to ask (partners.approvals.ask).
held.reading: Wait until the requests are read.
held.noKind: No approval is asked on this record.
held.notOpen: Only a request that still waits can be withdrawn.

ask.title: Ask a partner to approve

kindHint.CONCESSION: A deviation you ask the customer to accept.
kindHint.ARTWORK: An artwork or a logo, on its file.
kindHint.PROOF: The final design before cutting (made to measure).
kindHint.REVISED_ORDER: The order as revised, line by line: accepted as it stands or refused.
kindHint.SIGNATURE: An outside signature on this document's version.

ask.question: What do you ask them?
ask.questionHint: In your words: it is the first thing they read.
ask.dueHint: At least an hour from now, at most {days} days. The link stops working then.
ask.filesNeeded: Files that go with it (at least one)
ask.filesHint: A copy of each file you tick goes with the request, for this partner only.
ask.filesNone: This record has no file to send.
ask.filesNoneNeeded: This record has no file yet: add the photos or the file in Files first.
ask.mailBody: We send the link to the address below, with a receipt after their answer.
ask.linkBody: You get the link once, to send it yourself (a chat, your own e-mail).
ask.emailHint: The person who answers: the link works once.
ask.languageHint: The e-mail and the page in this language.

problem.question: Say what you ask them to approve.
problem.due: Choose when the answer is due.
problem.dueSoon: The answer is due at least an hour from now.
problem.dueLate: The answer is due within {days} days.
problem.dueRefused: This due time is not allowed for this kind.
problem.files: Tick at least one file: it is approved on its photos or file.
problem.filesRefused: A file is not current or not of this record: tick the current ones.
problem.kind: This record does not take this kind of approval.
problem.invalid: Something in the request is missing or not valid.
problem.suppressed: This address bounced or complained before: correct it first.
problem.refused: This request cannot go by link.
problem.held: This record cannot be asked about now.
problem.open: A request of this kind already waits on this record: withdraw it first.
problem.forbidden: You may not ask about this record.
problem.rateLimited: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
problem.unavailable: The service is not answering. Try again in a moment.
problem.failed: The request could not be made. Try again.

link.title: The link for {label}
link.once: It is shown only now: copy it and send it to the person who answers.

withdraw.title: Withdraw the {kind} request?
withdraw.body: {partner} can no longer answer: the link stops working and their task closes. You can ask again afterwards.

problem.failed: The request could not be withdrawn. Try again.
problem.changed: It changed meanwhile (answered or withdrawn): it was read again.
problem.forbidden: You may not withdraw this request.
problem.reason: The reason is too long: at most 500 characters.

problem.read: The approval requests could not be read.
problem.forbidden: You may not see the approvals of this record.
problem.unavailable: The service is not answering. Try again in a moment.

mailMe.label: E-mail me approvals that wait for me
mailMe.failed: Your setting could not be read.
mailMe.on: On: each one comes with a link that opens it after you sign in.
mailMe.refused: The setting could not be changed. Try again.

note.linkOnce: Asked. Copy the link below and send it yourself.
note.mailFailed: Asked, but the e-mail did not go out: withdraw it and ask again, or ask again by link.
note.mailQueued: Asked. The e-mail goes out in a moment.
note.mailed: Asked. The link went out by e-mail.
note.copyFailed: The link could not be copied: select it and copy it.
